entries.en: Raya-O-Senna would send you on a pilgrimage.
entries.macro: Raya<-->O<-->Senna would send you on a pilgrimage.
entries.fr: Raya-O-Senna a une chose importante à vous dire.

entries.en: Raya-O-Senna explains that in order to withstand the fury of the great one while performing the Quieting, you must clad yourself in garb imbued with the powers of your forebear. Take the items of clothing she has given you and /pray before three of A-Towa-Cant's resting places─in the Serpent's Tongue, the Tangle, and Raubahn's Push─that you might obtain the great mage's blessing.

entries.fr: Raya-O-Senna vous demande de suivre les traces d'A-Towa-Cant, et de vous rendre sur des stèles qui lui sont dédiées. Rendez-vous  au Nid de serpents dans la Noscea occidentale,  à L'Enchevêtrement dans le Mor Dhona,  à la Poussée de Raubahn dans le Thanalan, et priez devant chacun des monuments.

entries.en: Raya-O-Senna explains her reasons for sending you on the pilgrimage. It was not merely for the purpose of enchanting your ritual garb, but also because she wished for you to see with your own eyes the beauty and suffering of the realm, as A-Towa-Cant once did. Angered by the defilement of the great mage's resting place, she has vowed to find the culprit.

entries.fr: Vous avez raconté à Raya-O-Senna que la stèle d'A-Towa-Cant a été profanée. Elle bout de rage et jure de trouver le coupable. Continuez votre entraînement en lui laissant le soin de se charger de l'enquête...
entries.ja: ラヤ・オ・センナに報告した。彼女は墓荒らしに強い怒りを燃やしていた。必ずア・トワ・カントの聖櫃を盗んだ犯人を見つけ、取り返すことを、彼女は固く誓った。ア・トワ・カントの後継者として、犯人を見つけることに協力できるよう、さらなる修業を積もう。

entries.en: At its roots, the ritual is no different from the acts of pacifying that you have already performed. The difference lies only in the difficulty of the effort─the great one possesses a power unfathomably more immense than the elementals you have communed with thus far.
entries.fr: Pour interagir avec un esprit doyen aussi puissant que celui de l'Arbre gardien, il est nécessaire de porter une tenue spéciale, pour éviter d'être mis en danger par sa puissance.
entries.ja:
「長老の木」の大精霊と交感する時には、
その強い力に負けないために、特別な装束が必要になる。
あんたには、それを用意してほしいの。

entries.en: Power so immense that a mage might be easily overwhelmed by the sheer force of its will. To prevent such a catastrophic fate, our tradition decrees that especial garb must be donned before performing the ritual.
entries.fr: C'est une tenue que j'ai moi-même préparée. Mais dans son état actuel, elle n'a aucun pouvoir.
entries.ja:
これは、あたしが準備した装束よ。
だけどこのままでは、何の力も持っていないの。
entries.jaMacro:
これは、あたしが準備した装束よ。
だけどこのままでは、何の力も持っていないの。
entries.speaker: RAYAOSENNA

entries.en: I have prepared for you these pieces, but I fear they will not avail you in their current state. So it is that I would send you on a journey.
entries.fr: J'aimerais que tu insuffles le pouvoir de l'apaisement à cette tenue. Pour ce faire, je vais te demander de voyager à travers Éorzéa, afin de retracer le cheminement d'A-Towa-Cant.
entries.ja:
あんたにやってほしいのは、
装束に力を吹き込み「鎮めの装束」として仕上げること。
そのためには、エオルゼア各地を巡る必要があるわ。

entries.en: I trust you know the story of A-Towa-Cant. Rare among the Padjal, he left the forest behind to travel the realm, healing the land and its people. As tribute to his wanderlust, after he passed, his ashes were divided among several urns, which were in turn carried to the far reaches of the realm.
entries.macro: I trust you know the story of A<-->Towa<-->Cant. Rare among the Padjal, he left the forest behind to travel the realm, healing the land and its people. As tribute to his wanderlust, after he passed, his ashes were divided among several urns, which were in turn carried to the far reaches of the realm.
entries.fr: Il a eu une destinée assez singulière pour un Padjal, puisqu'il a parcouru le monde pour venir en aide aux gens et apporter la sérénité un peu partout en Éorzéa. Après sa mort, ses cendres ont été dispersées sur certains des endroits célèbres de son pèlerinage.
entries.ja:
ア・トワ様はね、角尊としては珍しく、
森を出て癒しの旅を続けておられたお方なの。
そして、死後にゆかりの地に分骨されたのよ。

entries.en: And it was there, in the distant lands that the great mage so loved, that his ashes were buried, and monuments erected in his honor. You are to go on a pilgrimage to these sites, and receive the blessings of your forebear. Only then will the garb I've gifted you be imbued with his divine powers.
entries.fr: Puisque tu es en quelque sorte son successeur, j'aimerais que tu ailles prier sur chacun des endroits où reposent les reliques d'A-Towa-Cant.
entries.ja:
、あんたは後継者として、
ア・トワ様の墓標を巡り、祈りを奉じて力を授かるのよ！

entries.en: Mind you, you will find that these places are not as welcoming as they might have been in Master A-Towa's time. The first site is on the shores of western La Noscea, in a place now feared as the Serpent's Tongue, home to a band of vile pirates.

entries.fr: Pour commencer,  se trouve dans la Noscea occidentale. Malheureusement, l'endroit est occupé par les pillards du serpent, une bande de pirates qui en a fait son repaire, si bien qu'on l'appelle “Nid de serpents”.
entries.ja:

でも今では、海賊団「海蛇の舌」のアジトと化し、
「海蛇の巣穴」と呼ばれている状態よ。

entries.en: The next is to be found in Mor Dhona, in that overgrown labyrinth of roots and vines so affectionately known as the Tangle. I do hope that Master A-Towa's ashes have survived those most oppressive environs.

entries.en: The third site I would have you visit is perhaps the most treacherous location of the lot─Raubahn's Push in northern Thanalan, a stone's throw from an imperial stronghold. I urge you to exercise extreme caution.
entries.fr: Enfin,  se trouve dans le Thanalan septentrional, à la Poussée de Raubahn. C'est tout près d'une base impériale, donc c'est un endroit un peu dangereux.

entries.en: Now that you have traveled the realm and seen the land as Master A-Towa did, I would share with you the rest of his tale. The histories claim that A-Towa-Cant disappeared in the mountains of O'Ghomoro, the kobold motherland. This is not untrue, but there is more to the story.

The histories claim that A<-->Towa<-->Cant disappeared in the mountains of O'Ghomoro, the kobold motherland. This is not untrue, but there is more to the story.
entries.fr: Chacune des stèles renferme une partie des reliques d'A-Towa-Cant.
entries.ja:
各地の墓には、ア・トワ・カント様のご遺骨が、
分骨されて納められているの。
entries.jaMacro:
各地の墓には、ア・トワ・カント様のご遺骨が、
分骨されて納められているの。
entries.speaker: RAYAOSENNA

entries.en: When the great mage did not return from his journey, one of his most devoted students went in search of him. As the legends have it, the young mage single-handedly fought off veritable legions of kobolds while scouring the mountains for any sign of his master.
entries.fr: Officiellement, A-Towa-Cant a disparu dans O'Ghomoro, mais en réalité un de ses fidèles a discrètement ramené sa dépouille.
entries.ja:
一般的には、ラノシアのオ・ゴモロ山で
行方不明ってことになってるんだけど……
実は従者のひとりがね、ご遺体を回収していたのよ。
entries.frMacro: Officiellement, A-Towa-Cant a disparu dans O'Ghomoro, mais en réalité un de ses fidèles a dis<->crè<->te<->ment ramené sa dépouille.

行方不明ってことになってるんだけど……
実は従者のひとりがね、ご遺体を回収していたのよ。
entries.speaker: RAYAOSENNA

entries.en: Sadly, it was as all had feared. Though the young mage eventually found his master, the great A-Towa-Cant lived no more.
entries.macro: Sadly, it was as all had feared. Though the young mage eventually found his master, the great A<-->Towa<-->Cant lived no more.
entries.fr: Apparemment, ce disciple s'est engouffré dans les montagnes d'O'Ghomoro, qui sont truffées de Kobolds, avec l'énergie du désespoir, pour ramener le corps du grand maître. Il a fait preuve d'un grand courage.
entries.ja:
なんでも、コボルド族がひしめくオ・ゴモロ山を、
その従者はご遺体を抱えて、決死の覚悟で突破したそうよ。
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en: As if the death of the man were not enough, Thyrus─A-Towa-Cant's great staff, a mighty relic passed down by his ancestors─was lost to the shadows.
entries.macro: As if the death of the man were not enough, Thyrus─A<-->Towa<-->Cant's great staff, a mighty relic passed down by his ancestors─was lost to the shadows.
entries.fr: Ce qui est malheureux, c'est que le Thyrse, le trésor de la famille Cant, a été perdu dans l'opération. Il s'agit d'un bâton d'élémentaliste célèbre.
entries.ja:
そのとき、残念なことに、
カント家の家宝でもあった名杖「タイラス」が、
失われてしまったのだけどね。

entries.en: Undeterred, the young mage fought off the kobold hordes to carry his master's remains back to the surface. A ceremony was held to honor Master A-Towa's life and deeds, and urns housing his ashes were carried off to the far-reaching frontiers of which he was so fond in his living years.

A ceremony was held to honor Master A<-->Towa's life and deeds, and urns housing his ashes were carried off to the far-reaching frontiers of which he was so fond in his living years.
entries.fr: Une fois la dépouille ramenée, il a été décidé qu'on enterre discrètement ses reliques dans des endroits appréciés du maître de son vivant.
entries.ja:
ともかく……グリダニアに戻られたア・トワ様のご遺体は、
従者の手によって分骨されて、あの方の愛された、
ほうぼうの土地へと埋葬された、というわけ。

entries.en:
All the urns, that is, except for one. Yes, though the precise location is known to only a few, Master A-Towa also rests closer to home. Here in the Twelveswood, not far from Proud Creek, you will find yet another monument to the great mage.
Take with you this habit, and pay your respects as before. If you keep pure intentions in your heart and in your mind, then the healer's robe shall be your reward.

中身は何者かに奪い去られてしまったようだ。

entries.en: The urn holding Master A-Towa's ashes was stolen!? This cannot be!
entries.macro: The urn holding Master A<-->Towa's ashes was stolen!? This cannot be!
entries.fr: Quoi !? La tombe d'A-Towa-Cant a été profanée !? C'est vrai ?
entries.ja:
ア・トワ様の墓が、墓荒らしに暴かれていた！？
ほ……本当なの、それは！？

entries.en: Grave robbery is a damnable enough crime in itself, but what manner of scoundrel would dare defile the resting place of a Padjal?
entries.fr: C'est vraiment honteux, endommager la tombe d'un Padjal...
entries.ja:
なんてことなの……
まさか「角尊」の墓を暴く、不心得者がいるなんて！
人心の乱れ、ここに極まれりよね……。

entries.en: Rest assured that I will investigate this heinous crime immediately. In the meantime, your pilgrimage demands you travel to one last destination.
entries.fr: Enfin, ce qui est fait est fait. Je vais essayer de découvrir qui aurait pu commettre un tel acte... Pendant ce temps, va visiter la dernière stèle.
entries.ja:
ともかく、荒らされてしまったものは仕方ないわね。
墓荒らしの正体は、あたしのほうで詳しく調べておくから、
あんたは最後の墓標に向かってくれる？

entries.en: This final leg of your journey will take you to the very place that Master A-Towa drew his last breath: O'Ghomoro, the homeland of the kobolds in outer La Noscea. It is there, in plain sight of the Kobold Dig, that the student of whom I spoke did erect a monument to his fallen master.

entries.fr: C'est près d'O'Ghomoro, à l'excavation kobolde, le site même où le Padjal a perdu la vie... et c'est le dernier endroit où ses reliques reposent.
entries.ja:
場所は外地ラノシアの「コボルド軍試掘地」のすぐ近く。
そう……ア・トワ様が亡くなった、
オ・ゴモロ山のすぐ近くに、最後の墓標があるわ。

entries.en: In your travels, you have received the blessings of our great ancestor. And yet, this was not the sole reason I sent you on this pilgrimage. Perhaps you sensed something of my intentions during your trip.
entries.fr: Mais tu as littéralement suivi les traces d'A-Towa-Cant en empruntant ce chemin.
entries.ja:
でも、あんたが訪ね歩いた墓標の場所こそ、
生前にア・トワ・カント様の歩まれた、足跡なのよ。

entries.en: Yes, . As  who would inherit Master A-Towa's legacy, I wanted you to truly walk in his footsteps.

entries.fr: Il a vraiment parcouru les quatre coins du monde, en quittant la Sylve malgré le fait qu'il soit un Padjal.
entries.ja:
「角尊」でありながら、黒衣森を出て、
世界を旅し……そして果てたア・トワ様。
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en: To see the realm─in both its beauty and its suffering─with your own eyes, as the great mage did so long ago.
entries.fr: Je souhaitais donc que tu voies les mêmes paysages que lui, que tu comprennes sa façon de penser pour lui succéder comme il se doit.
entries.ja:
ただ、力を受け継ぐだけじゃない。
あの方が何を思い、何を見ていたのか。
後継者であるあんたに、それを知っておいてほしかった。

entries.en: And yet it is strange, no? A pirate's lair, a rampant jungle, mountains of fire─of all the hostile environs to which you journeyed, the single grave despoiled was that which rests right here in our forest home.
entries.fr: Mais tout de même... je n'aurais pas cru que des profanateurs pouvaient se trouver ici, à Gridania...
entries.ja:
それにしても……よもや、このグリダニアで
墓荒らしなんていう、ろくでなしが出るとはね……。
entries.jaMacro:
それにしても……よもや、このグリダニアで

entries.en: I suspect this was the handiwork of no witless grave robber, but rather someone who knew all too well the value of that which was buried within.
entries.fr: Ou bien, c'est peut-être justement pour ça que... Hum...
entries.ja:
……いえ、むしろグリダニアだからなのかも。
角尊の尊さを知るからこそ、その墓を暴いた……？

entries.en: We must uncover the truth behind this crime and return Master A-Towa's ashes to their rightful resting place, and quickly. You are with me, yes?

何にせよ、捨て置くわけにはいかない。
必ず、墓荒らしを見つけだすわよ、いいわね！
